item.name: List Interviews
item.description: Returns compact interview dashboard data with two schedule groups: `today` and `upcoming`. Use `groups[].interviews` as the canonical list for the schedule UI. Row items include only id, applicant_id, candidate/job labels, scheduled date/time, duration, type/round labels, and status. Use Get Interview for full notes/link/raw fields.

item.name: Schedule Interview
item.description: `type` is the meeting mode (video, phone, in_person). `round_type` is the interview round (intro_call, technical, culture_fit, final_round, portfolio_review, other). `duration_minutes` must be an integer minute value such as 30 or 60, not a label like "30 minutes".

item.name: Start Hosted Checkout
item.description: Starts recruiter plan checkout. Stripe returns checkout_url. PayPal sets checkout_url to null and returns a paypal object for the JS SDK, including paypal.subscription_id and paypal.plan_id for the embedded subscription approval flow.

item.name: Update Subscription
item.description: Manual subscription switch endpoint. If a current online subscription exists, API now attempts to cancel it at Stripe/PayPal before activating the new local subscription.

item.name: Cancel Subscription
item.description: Cancels recruiter subscription in remote gateway (Stripe/PayPal) first when payment_id exists, then marks local subscription as cancelled.

item.name: Stripe Webhook - Credit Pack Checkout Completed
item.description: Example Stripe webhook payload for completing a credit pack purchase. Signature must be generated with the configured Stripe webhook secret.

item.name: PayPal Webhook - Credit Pack Capture Completed
item.description: Example PayPal webhook payload for completing a credit pack purchase from a captured order. PayPal webhook signature headers must be valid.
